title:
REST type for SendGrid APIs. To use the API, generate the API token within SendGrid.
@see https://sendgrid.com/docs/API_Reference/api_getting_started.html

Once the token is created, you can use the script below in static console to configure the API url and auth token:
```
SendGridApi.setApiUrlAndAuth(
  'https://api.sendgrid.com/v3', // The API url
  'Bearer <token>', // The API token generated in SendGrid
  ConfigOverride.CLUSTER
)
```

Note that for email address validation, there is another {@link SendGridEmailAddressValidationApi} API type
because SendGrid requires users to generate a separate API token to validate email addresses.
name: SendGridApi
